note: Curated, conservative mapping; presence of a suite does not prove a feature passed or the UI was tested.

systems.evidence: Saved deck edits, copy limits, format preflight, import/export.
systems.manual_check: Open saved and EDH Lab editors; change test draft, undo, verify save and card counts.
systems.gap: Undo/redo and WPF input focus are not demonstrated by headless tests.

systems.evidence: Grouped draft data and image lookup are behaviorally tested; WPF control presence is source-checked.
systems.manual_check: Try collapse/expand, composition, F3/Shift+F3, Ctrl+F, Enter, and full detail dialog.
systems.gap: No automated rendered-WPF layout or mouse/keyboard interaction test.

systems.evidence: Printing IDs, official art URLs, offline metadata and cover fallback logic.
systems.manual_check: Preview Island (FIN) 297 and several nonbasic/double-face cards; verify real image display.
systems.gap: Actual image download, cache display and failures on a real device remain manual.

systems.evidence: Cached library, match W/L aggregates and verified deck association.
systems.manual_check: Switch between two known tracked decks and All Decks; compare totals with captured matches.
systems.gap: Live match-to-screen refresh and Xeneon synchronization need manual validation.

systems.evidence: Synthetic logs, match attribution, ranked metadata and conservative public-card opponent evidence.
systems.manual_check: Capture a real Arena match and compare rank, W/L and partial observed opponent colors.
systems.gap: Live Player.log variants, rotated logs and hidden-information edge cases remain partially covered.

systems.evidence: Physical and Arena ownership, proxy isolation, quantity consistency, and the native Arena presentation model.
systems.manual_check: Convert a test card to proxy and back; verify no real ownership or valuation drift.
systems.gap: Complete mobile peer ownership behavior requires device tests.

systems.evidence: Workspace persistence, synthetic crash boundaries, backup reading and recovery.
systems.manual_check: Back up a disposable snapshot and inspect recovery controls without overwriting live data.
systems.gap: Real-machine installation/restore across app versions remains manual.

systems.evidence: Synthetic merge, bulk import, migration preview and staging paths.
systems.manual_check: Sync disposable Windows/Android copies; verify conflict selections and diff behavior.
systems.gap: Android side and Wi-Fi/USB transport are not covered by these Windows suites.

systems.evidence: Search/filter, set totals, pricing-related owned values, shortlist and roles.
systems.manual_check: Search keywords and sets; verify one-set progress invalidation, icon/art, and prices.
systems.gap: Live Scryfall/network refresh and actual UI redraw timing remain manual.

systems.evidence: EDH draft rules, land advisors, mana-base suggestions and validation.
systems.manual_check: Review suggested substitutions and mana balance on a sample Commander deck.
systems.gap: Quality of recommendations and real-session usability need human review.

systems.evidence: Update logic, source structure, themes, release notes and synthetic collection-scale checks.
systems.manual_check: Upgrade installed preview, launch from pinned shortcut, resize panels and uninstall.
systems.gap: No automated installed-app GUI, keyboard accessibility or rollback drill.

systems.evidence: Adjacent deck/image source regression only; not an end-to-end widget test.
systems.manual_check: Rename a deck, update W/L and artwork, verify Xeneon Edge updates promptly.
systems.gap: No dedicated executable/device widget integration test; source tests are not widget coverage.

systems.evidence: No Android instrumentation tests are part of this Windows-only runner.
systems.manual_check: Check Android catalog, EDH Lab, tabletop life tracker and USB/wireless sync separately.
systems.gap: Android automated suite and device integration belong to a separate mobile pipeline.
